hebrewText: וְ֠/עַתָּה בְּֽנוֹתֵי/כֶ֞ם אַל תִּתְּנ֣וּ לִ/בְנֵי/הֶ֗ם וּ/בְנֹֽתֵי/הֶם֙ אַל תִּשְׂא֣וּ לִ/בְנֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹֽא תִדְרְשׁ֧וּ שְׁלֹמָ֛/ם וְ/טוֹבָתָ֖/ם עַד עוֹלָ֑ם לְמַ֣עַן תֶּחֶזְק֗וּ וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּם֙ אֶת ט֣וּב הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/הוֹרַשְׁתֶּ֥ם לִ/בְנֵי/כֶ֖ם עַד עוֹלָֽם

tokens.kjv: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, [phrase] how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ([phrase] as) yet.

tokens.bdb: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
tokens.kjv: alway(-s), ancient (time), any more, continuance, eternal, (for, (n-)) ever(-lasting, -more, of old), lasting, long (time), (of) old (time), perpetual, at any time, (beginning of the) world ([phrase] without end). Compare H5331 (נֶצַח), H5703 (עַד).

tokens.bdb: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
tokens.kjv: because of, to the end (intent) that, for (to,... 's sake), [phrase] lest, that, to.

tokens.kjv: aid, amend, [idiom] calker, catch, cleave, confirm, be constant, constrain, continue, be of good (take) courage(-ous, -ly), encourage (self), be established, fasten, force, fortify, make hard, harden, help, (lay) hold (fast), lean, maintain, play the man, mend, become (wax) mighty, prevail, be recovered, repair, retain, seize, be (wax) sore, strengthen (self), be stout, be (make, shew, wax) strong(-er), be sure, take (hold), be urgent, behave self valiantly, withstand.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
